en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding
a man who ate from the flesh of a hunted prey not knowing what it was, and he was in Ihraam. Heasws said: ‘Upon him is blood of a sheep’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from in a marfu‘ manner the following: “About a man who in the state of Ihram eats of the flesh of a prey and does not know what it is, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
